basic_details.job_title: RKMVERI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra (SSKVK) of Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute (RKMVERI) will fill one Project Assistant post on a fully contractual basis at Rs. 15,000 a month, consolidated. The post is under a project funded by the Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA), South 24 Parganas, on a herbal teat dip and oral immunomodulator for sub-clinical mastitis in crossbred dairy cows. Applicants need to be below 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026, with Higher Secondary (HS) pass and a 1-year certificate course in animal husbandry/veterinary science.

age_limit.details: The age limit is below 40 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice mentions no age relaxation. The application form asks for the applicant's age on 1 January 2026 in years, months and days. | The notice says candidates are themselves responsible for confirming that they meet the required qualification and experience. For discipline-specific eligibility, check the official notification.

qualification.details: Higher Secondary (HS) pass from any recognised council. A 1-year certificate course in animal husbandry/veterinary science from the West Bengal Veterinary Education Board or from any recognised institution.

how_to_apply: Email your relevant biodata, in the attached format, to [email protected] and [email protected]. The notice also asks candidates to contact Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra immediately.

Fill in the application form printed in the notice. It asks for the applicant's name, parent's or guardian's name, date of birth (certificate to be attached), age on 1 January 2026, present and permanent address, mobile numbers and email address.
Add educational qualification details in the table on the form (exam passed, year, board/university, subject, percentage of marks), with attested copies of the marksheets or certificates.
Add experience details in the form's experience table (post and employer, period of service, nature of work, reason for leaving), with attested copies of the certificates.
Paste a passport-size colour photograph on the form, sign it and add the date and place. The form carries a declaration that the information given is true.
Bring the hard copy of the form and the documents listed below to the interview.
Hard copy of the correctly filled application form (attached to the notice).
Original and self-attested photocopy of proof of date of birth (Madhyamik admit card).
Original and self-attested photocopy of the educational qualification marksheet and degree.
Original and self-attested photocopy of the experience certificate and other relevant documents.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is paid for taking part in a written test, interview or skill test. If any information given is found false or incorrectly certified, the candidature may be cancelled or rejected. If any detail is found wrong or tampered with after the appointment, the engagement is treated as cancelled with immediate effect and without notice, according to the declaration on the form. The notice says that legal action will be taken if false information is found at any stage. The engagement is valid only up to the end of the project, 31 March 2027, and gives no claim to a temporary or permanent post.

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the Kendra
content_sections.text: Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra is a centre of Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute. It is located at Arapanch, Sonarpur, Kolkata. The Project Assistant will work under the ATMA-funded project named in the table above, which concerns sub-clinical mastitis in crossbred dairy cows and anti-microbial resistance. The notice does not list the duties of the post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Higher Secondary (HS) pass from any recognised council. A 1-year certificate course in animal husbandry/veterinary science from the West Bengal Veterinary Education Board or from any recognised institution. Diploma in veterinary science. Skill in MS Office. The age limit is below 40 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice mentions no age relaxation. The application form asks for the applicant's age on 1 January 2026 in years, months and days. The notice says candidates are themselves responsible for confirming that they meet the required qualification and experience. For discipline-specific eligibility, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly consolidated remuneration of Rs. 15,000. The engagement is entirely contractual and temporary, and it is valid until the project ends on 31 March 2027. It gives no right to claim a temporary or permanent post. No TA/DA is payable for attending a written test, interview or skill test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RKMVERI Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Email your relevant biodata, in the attached format, to [email protected] and [email protected] . The notice also asks candidates to contact Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra immediately. Fill in the application form printed in the notice. It asks for the applicant's name, parent's or guardian's name, date of birth (certificate to be attached), age on 1 January 2026, present and permanent address, mobile numbers and email address. Add educational qualification details in the table on the form (exam passed, year, board/university, subject, percentage of marks), with attested copies of the marksheets or certificates. Add experience details in the form's experience table (post and employer, period of service, nature of work, reason for leaving), with attested copies of the certificates. Paste a passport-size colour photograph on the form, sign it and add the date and place. The form carries a declaration that the information given is true. Bring the hard copy of the form and the documents listed below to the interview. Hard copy of the correctly filled application form (attached to the notice). Original and self-attested photocopy of proof of date of birth (Madhyamik admit card). Original and self-attested photocopy of the educational qualification marksheet and degree. Original and self-attested photocopy of the experience certificate and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: An interview will be held to fill the Project Assistant post. The date and time will be announced later. The venue is the Seminar Room, Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute, Arapanch, Sonarpur, Kolkata. The interview date, results and details of joining will be displayed on the official website of SSKVK, RKMVERI. Applicants will not be sent any information individually, so they must check the website regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts are there at RKMVERI?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Project Assistant post at Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra, RKMVERI, on a fully temporary contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the RKMVERI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need Higher Secondary (HS) pass from any recognised council and a 1-year certificate course in animal husbandry/veterinary science from the West Bengal Veterinary Education Board or any recognised institution. A diploma in veterinary science and skill in MS Office are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the RKMVERI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the RKMVERI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 15,000/- (Rupees fifteen thousand only).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RKMVERI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email your relevant biodata, in the attached format, to [email protected] and [email protected], or contact Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra. Bring the filled application form and documents to the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be at the Seminar Room, Sasya Shyamala Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute, Arapanch, Sonarpur, Kolkata. The date and time will be notified later.

faq.question: Q7. Is the RKMVERI Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is fully contractual and valid up to the end of the project on 31 March 2027. It gives no right to claim a temporary or permanent post.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for taking part in a written test, interview or skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form in hard copy, and the original and a self-attested photocopy of the date of birth proof (Madhyamik admit card), the marksheet and degree, and the experience certificate and other relevant documents.
